brief:
Israel is accelerating settlement construction across the occupied West Bank through new projects designed to expand territorial control, according to Shehab Wire. The National Office for Land Defense and Anti-Settlement Resistance reported the escalation, noting that Israeli settlers are executing the schemes with direct support from the Israeli military.

The office characterized the initiatives as a systematic effort to reshape the demographic and geographic landscape of the territory, though details on specific locations and project timelines were not immediately available.

title: Israel escalates West Bank settlement expansion plans
